correctness.rationale: On compact support strictly inside the positive quadrant, stationarity of \(\log x\) and \(\log y\) is legitimate. Exact algebra yields the weighted-square mean defect and the quadratic variance shell. Positivity gives \(\alpha<\bar x<1\), and equality in the defect forces the unique coexistence equilibrium. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2022 full text treats equilibria, Hopf bifurcation, first Lyapunov coefficient, and numerical stable cycles but does not state the paired finite-amplitude invariant-measure laws. value.rationale: The source centers on Hopf-born oscillatory coexistence. The paired identities impose exact finite-amplitude constraints on every compact interior recurrent statistical state: a strict prey-mean displacement and an exact tradeoff between mean predator density and prey variance. This is a natural structural diagnostic for the model’s oscillatory regime rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
